preferences.rule: Rose brand, slate secondary system; distinct canvas, cards, top and bottom chrome. Preserve neutral readable copy.
Three emphasis tiers. Secondary has explicit utility, entry and recovery roles. Intent and wording do not determine emphasis. Destructive is a separate intent.
Soft neutral slate with a stronger label; recovery must outrank Back navigation. Keep its fill steady on hover.

Contextual navigation: outside a card/panel, use muted regular plain text, left chevron and underline only on hover/focus, without fill or shadow. Inside a card/panel, use a bounded secondary utility or tertiary button treatment. Preserve anchor semantics for URL navigation.
Gentle Light shadows; compact tinted directional depth in Dark. No large surrounding halo or pulsing shine. Stable solid fills, small hover boosts.
Bounded quiet fill/border and flat at rest; functional tertiary has subtle fine-pointer hover lift/depth. Compact tools remain flat.
Filled selected glyph plus stronger caption. No surrounding selection tile, border, underline marker or boxed pointer hover. Keep keyboard focus visible.
Keep a moving soft tile. Use the same selected glyph family as mobile. Reserve expansion space; changing selection must not shift neighbors.
Calm glide; reduced motion makes state changes instant and removes lifts/nudges. No decorative logo motion.
Compact overlaid dropdown attached below the header. Fill corner gaps, preserve visible header rim/shadow above menu, and do not push the page.

Header TOP edge has no bright rim/reflection. Header lower edge and bottom bar upper edge retain the same 2px highlight plus 1px seam in both themes. Top lower corners 10px; bottom upper corners 12px. No gradient band.
When a persistent primary is useful, retain the rounded rectangle behind it. Float the entire tray over content, disconnected from bottom navigation. Content scrolls behind; end padding clears it.
Preserve CU Ways logos and role-bird artwork. Sun means current Light, moon current Dark; accessible name announces next theme. Do not adopt the rejected role-pill redesign.

Feedback banners contain message content only. Put message-associated Retry/Refresh/Reopen/Check controls in an adjacent, unpainted sibling group via feedbackBlock. Primary domain actions such as Start stay in their action panel/tray; they are not banner controls. All message shapes share an icon column and one copy column. Keep neutral title/body copy and outer borders; semantic signal belongs to the icon/rail and quiet fill.

Use intrinsic, responsive composition and relative sizing. Avoid redundant subtitles, give title/filter a coherent group, and choose density from real content. Do not transplant demo positions or gaps.
Preserve focus, text scaling, safe areas, pending/disabled semantics, reduced transparency and reduced motion. Test actual composed surfaces.
Inherit global defaults. A story/page may specialize semantic/component aliases with an explicit scope, reason and evidence; shared changes require a versioned global decision.

Use one local SVG refresh arrow for read/retry/refresh actions, with a continuous rounded path and visible label. Busy uses a smooth single-arc spinner, never a segmented or recycling-arrow glyph. Decorative icons are aria-hidden. Reduced motion keeps a static arc and busy text.

Use runnable local HTML/CSS/JS for current and future story design, parameter tuning, effects, motion and handoff. Global component reference and story demo consume the same canonical package. Figma/SVG exports are historical snapshots; do not update them unless explicitly requested again.

Live tuning creates a versioned draft proposal, not an automatic canonical edit. Export/import records its base version and scope. Promote reviewed shared changes through theme.json, regenerate, and verify both the component reference and affected story.

Use the selected Round10 shell proportions and typography with later user corrections. Header controls and attached menu rows are their own shared chrome primitives, not tiered action buttons. The lab and story must use the same rendered component markup and recipes.

Choose one return action per destination/state. Do not repeat Back to My Jobs in both page chrome and status cards. Keep mobile pagination to arrows plus a compact page indicator with full accessible names.

Before handoff, ask a fresh unbiased agent to inspect actual rendered screens against the user reference and report visual/interaction concerns. The implementation owner accepts or rejects findings with evidence; passing tests do not substitute for visual review.

Use the shared message-only banner and structured feedbackBlock for adjacent recovery controls in every current HTML consumer. Warning uses a muted amber icon/rail on Slate fill, distinct from error red and info/success signals. Do not duplicate message copy in the following card or repeat its recovery control elsewhere. Preserve primary domain actions in their owning panel/tray.

Lifecycle/status badges anchor at the upper right of the owning entity heading or card. Use intrinsic grid reflow; at narrow enlarged text give the right-aligned badge its own upper row rather than squeezing identity/title. Attachment tags and checklist icons remain their own content types.

guidance.units: rem/em for text, targets, icons and spacing; unitless line-height; percentages for weights/alpha. px for thin edges, optical corrections, bounded blur/shadow and explicitly chosen bar corners. Never shrink the root font to preserve screenshots.
guidance.spacing: Use a small relative scale; adjacent control gaps about0.4–0.75em, section gaps about1–2rem and page gutters about1–2rem are starting ranges, not constraints. Let content wrap and containers reflow.
guidance.navigation: Choose the compact/desktop transition where labels plus utilities fit at enlarged text. Keep hit areas independent of painted selection. Start at3.5–4.5rem nav row; grow for labels/safe area. Reserve icon slot and label metrics; active glyph about1.1 times inactive and hover midpoint about1.05.
guidance.tray: Start around0.5–1rem inset/gap; use measured rendered tray height for scroll-end clearance. Content viewport extends behind tray to nav. Avoid fixed bottom math; add safe area once and account for zoom/keyboard/short height.
guidance.shadows: Reviewed geometry: contact0 1px2px and ambient0 3px8px, zero spread. Keep decorative depth compact; offset/blur may be optically adjusted for control scale within roughly2–12px, not in proportion to viewport width.
guidance.caps: Light default ambient alpha: primary12%, secondary10%, utility6%; preferred ceilings15%,12%,8%. Solid hover increase usually0–2 percentage points. Recalibrate only with evidence.
guidance.radii: Preserve approved top10px/bottom12px/action-tray16px references. Adapt control/card radius to size, starting0.625–0.875rem. Avoid giant pill buttons unless the component warrants it.
guidance.feedback: Use one icon column and one copy column for title-only, body-only and title/body messages. Keep neutral copy, relative spacing and unpainted adjacent recovery actions. Primary domain controls remain in their task panel/tray. Tone follows the actual state: failure=error, unresolved caution=warning, neutral update=info, confirmed success=success; a lifecycle badge is not a banner.
guidance.handoff: Default to one runnable HTML system with global component and story views; local fonts/assets, no network dependency, explicit fixture data and deterministic mock outcomes. Preserve dynamic relative layout and describe unresolved components rather than inventing global page coordinates.
guidance.rating: Review-count bars use one restrained neutral series; star symbols remain distinct. Numeric values always remain visible. Avoid warning-like or decorative gradients for counts.

openDecisions: Global font-family migration: marketer uses Inter, root uses Geist. No universal font family was approved.
Forms, input/validation states, tables, charts, tabs, pagination, sidebars, tooltips, toasts, uploads, date pickers and other unshown components need local design and validation.
Global disabled/busy colors and alpha were not settled; do not adopt demo opacity as a rule. Pending vs disabled semantics must remain distinguishable.
Route inventory, mobile destination count, More behavior and route matching are product decisions; My Jobs is not automatically added to current frontend routes.
Breakpoint, bar height, tray eligibility, card density, title scale and page/container widths depend on real content and input behavior.
Complete dropdown/dialog keyboard and focus management requires implementation validation; demo behavior is not the contract.
Focus color and field/inline-link tokens are provisional until tested across the actual UI.
Native-device glass, browser zoom, localization, virtual keyboard and safe-area behavior require real runtime checks.
Dark/light optical equality is a visual judgment even when geometry is identical; no blanket accessibility certification.

allowed: semantic/component aliases in an opt-in scope
layout, density and content-specific responsive composition
new status labels mapped by meaning to semantic status families
restricted: new global token values without shared decision
specialization.promotion: Promote repeated successful overrides into a versioned global decision; retire local duplication.
